top5.title: CRISPR-Cas Tools for Dissecting and Engineering Environmental Responses in Microalgae
top5.why: CRISPR-Cas enables precise genetic dissection of photosynthesis and stress-response networks in microalgae, and supports engineering of stress-tolerant strains with retained productivity.

top5.title: PACS1 syndrome variant alters the proteomic landscape of developing cortical organoids
top5.why: Proteomics of PACS1 syndrome organoids reveals dysregulated pathways missed by transcriptomics, identifying additional therapeutic targets in neurodevelopmental disease mechanisms.

top5.title: Genome-wide CRISPR screening identified hemojuvelin as a non-neuronal receptor for the botulinum neurotoxin serotypes A and C
top5.why: Hemojuvelin mediates botulinum neurotoxin A and C binding to muscle sarcolemma, acting as a prerequisite receptor for toxin accumulation at neuromuscular junctions.

top5.title: A phase III randomized study: Immunogenicity and safety of a quadrivalent meningococcal conjugate vaccine in healthy adults, adolescents, and children in India and healthy adolescents and children in South Africa
top5.why: MenACYW-TT demonstrates non-inferior immunogenicity to MenACYW-DT and comparable safety across children, adolescents, and adults in India and South Africa.

top5.title: Systematic benchmarking of ambient RNA decontamination tools to advance precision in single-cell transcriptomic analysis
top5.why: DecontX, scAR, and CellClear show distinct performance profiles for removing ambient RNA contamination in single-cell RNA-seq, with tool selection depending on whether accuracy, robustness, or subtype resolution is prioritized.

also.title: Bioengineering strategies for improving the immunogenicity of mRNA vaccines
also.why: mRNA vaccine immunogenicity depends on coordinated optimization of RNA architecture, nucleotide modifications, and delivery systems to tune antigen expression and innate immune activation for disease-specific applications.

also.title: CD73 disruption with tumor-specific CRISPR/Cas9 nanoparticles reduces adenosine-mediated immunosuppression and amplifies response to chemotherapy
also.why: Tumor-specific CRISPR/Cas9 nanoparticles targeting CD73 across multiple TME cell types synergize with chemotherapy to reduce adenosine-mediated immunosuppression and improve survival in melanoma and triple-negative breast cancer models.

also.title: Human lung organoid modelling of tissue-resident antiviral T cell responses
also.why: Lung organoids with intact resident immune cells demonstrate that tissue-resident memory T cells can provide local antiviral protection independent of secondary lymphoid organs.

also.title: Genomic convergence of mobilome-associated multidrug resistance and host-adaptation determinants in a postoperative Raoultella ornithinolytica isolate carrying bla (KPC-2), bla (NDM-5,) and a truncated mcr-10-like element
also.why: Raoultella ornithinolytica can harbor multiple transferable plasmids carrying KPC-2, NDM-5, and other resistance genes alongside host-adaptation determinants, indicating potential for interspecies dissemination.

also.title: Exploring the immunological effects of antibody-drug conjugates
also.why: ADCs activate multiple immunomodulatory pathways beyond direct cytotoxicity, including immunogenic cell death and dendritic cell activation, supporting combinations with checkpoint inhibitors and novel design strategies.

also.title: Pregnancy establishment in cattle without embryonic interferon tau
also.why: IFNT is not required for pregnancy recognition, luteal maintenance, or full-term gestation in cattle, indicating alternative embryo-maternal signaling mechanisms sustain pregnancy establishment.
